text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: runtime container crashloop observed on pool-gpu (gpu-node-17) — segfault x8 in last 5m. PagerDuty routed to @oncall-ian. Severity: potential customer impact.
oncall-ian: ack — I'm taking it. tagging eng-runtime and sre-ops.
marta: I see repeated stack smash / abort traces in the coredump. attaching top lines: 
```
runtime[pid=2104] SIGSEGV at 0x0 ip=0x7f9d13b2c1a0 rlib_custom_cuda_kernel+0x1f2
#0 rlib_custom_cuda_kernel() 
#1 runtime::dispatch+0x4b
#2 vllm::serve::run+0x7a
```
also saw a prior OOM on the same container before the segfault.
kai: any customer-facing errors? metrics?
marta: yes — embedding API 503s spiked from 0.3% -> 12% in us-west-2 over last 6m. dashboard: https://dash.company/ops/embeddings/us-west-2 (link).
eng-runtime: preliminary hypothesis: heap overflow in the rlib_custom_cuda_kernel introduced by the recent int8 quant path. reproduced locally with model variant rtdl-int8-small.
oncall-ian: short-term mitigation options? suggest cordon + drain node, route traffic off pool, and deploy runtime flag to disable the fused kernel path.
sre-ops: cordoning gpu-node-17 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17` — starting drain of pods. will spin up replacement nodes.
marta: logs show this sequence: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` -> quick restart -> segfault stack smash. seems like a double-fault pattern.
eng-runtime: pushing a canary build that forces fallback to non-fused kernels: runtime flag `--disable-fused-kernels=true`. will patch 2 pods first.
kai: can we route traffic via smart-routing to avoid this pool while we validate?
oncall-ian: yes, switching routing policy for embeddings->us-west-2 to prefer other pools (taking latency hit). doing that now.
eng-runtime: canary 1/2 restarted, no crash after 6m. canary 2/2 started, monitoring. if both stable for 10m we'll roll. :thumbsup:
sre-ops: one residual crashloop observed on gpu-node-19 with NVLINK errors; isolating that node as well.
customer-success: preparing a customer update for affected tenants — initial note is drafted, ETA 25m for first outbound.
oncall-ian: plan for handoff: I'll stay on until 1h after rollout completes. if stable at +30m, will do a soft handoff to night oncall @marta. please capture steps taken.
marta: copying remediation steps to the incident doc. will include the coredump snippet and the canary run results.
eng-runtime: follow-up: we have a small patch to bounds-check the kernel; will schedule full rollout after validation.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2. New incident channel created: #incident-4951236789 (auto).
oncall-ian: quick note — customers affected: three high-traffic tenants in us-west-2. CS will send targeted updates.
customer-success: sending initial notifications now.
sre-ops: node drain complete on gpu-node-17, replacement nodes in service. monitoring error rate.
eng-runtime: canary behavior stable at +12m, proceeding with gradual rollout. will keep an eye on memory profiles.
oncall-ian: if we see reoccurrence, we'll revert routing and re-cordon affected nodes. otherwise we'll keep incident open for postmortem. handing off in 45m.
marta: acknowledged. adding tags: runtime-segfault, stack-smash, cuda-oom, canary-hotpatch.
eng-runtime: note to self: run ASAN+UBSAN on kernel emulation to catch heap overrun.
incident-bot: Incident updated: open -> monitoring.
